headline: Aniimo Team Roles
title: Aniimo Team Building | 5 Roles Every Team Needs | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Building an Aniimo team? Think in roles, not just elements. There are five roles. DPS deals the main damage. Breaker drains the enemy stance bar to open a window. Support adds buffs and debuffs. Healer keeps you alive. And Regen restores energy for longer fights. A good plan: let your Breaker open, hit hard with your DPS, and keep a Healer or Regen behind them. What is your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo team building: five roles - DPS, Breaker, Support, Healer and Regen. Cover the roles first, open with a Breaker and follow up with your DPS.
